en.tagline: Premium roofing, restoration, and architectural excellence
en.heroHeadline: Your roof isn't just shelter. It's architecture.
en.heroSub: For 16 years, Summit Roofing has built roofs that last generations and look intentional. We work with architects, builders, and homeowners who demand craftsmanship.
en.about: Summit Roofing is an established roofing and restoration firm serving the Phoenix area for 16 years. We specialize in high-end residential and light commercial roofing, historic restoration, and architectural details. Every project is led by a master craftsman with 20+ years of experience.

services.name: Architectural roofing
services.blurb: High-end roofs designed with architects. Custom details, premium materials, lasting craftsmanship.

services.name: Historic restoration
services.blurb: Period-correct restoration of slate, tile, and copper roofs. Preserving Arizona's architectural heritage.

services.name: Premium installation & maintenance
services.blurb: Master-level installation and long-term maintenance of premium roofing systems.

services.name: Consultations & design
services.blurb: Detailed roof consultations and design reviews for architects and builders.

reviews.quote: We brought in Summit Roofing on a high-end residential project. Their attention to detail and collaboration with our architect was exceptional. The roof is stunning.
reviews.author: Anderson Architects

reviews.quote: Restored our 1960s home's original tile roof with period-correct materials and techniques. They understood the architectural significance. Perfection.
reviews.author: Eleanor H.

reviews.quote: Not just roofers. Craftsmen who understand architecture. Working with them elevated our entire project.
reviews.author: Sterling Builders

es.tagline: Techos premium, restauración y excelencia arquitectónica
es.heroHeadline: Tu techo no es solo refugio. Es arquitectura.
es.heroSub: Durante 16 años, Summit Roofing ha construido techos que duran generaciones. Trabajamos con arquitectos y constructores que exigen artesanía.
es.about: Summit Roofing es una empresa establecida de techos y restauración que sirve al área de Phoenix durante 16 años. Nos especializamos en techos residenciales de alta gama y restauración histórica.

services.name: Techos arquitectónicos
services.blurb: Techos de alta gama diseñados con arquitectos. Detalles personalizados, materiales premium.

services.name: Restauración histórica
services.blurb: Restauración históricamente correcta de techos de pizarra, baldosa y cobre.

services.name: Instalación y mantenimiento premium
services.blurb: Instalación a nivel maestro y mantenimiento a largo plazo de sistemas de techos premium.

services.name: Consultas y diseño
services.blurb: Consultas detalladas de techos y revisiones de diseño para arquitectos y constructores.
